productReasons.claim: Mix visual workflow steps with JavaScript/Python and direct HTTP/GraphQL calls.
Add AI agents, MCP tools and human approval steps within deterministic workflows.
Use reusable integration nodes and execution history to build and inspect cross-application workflows.
